failure_modes.name: Swappable battery latch/BMS fault
failure_modes.component: Swappable battery pack, latch, and BMS
failure_modes.symptoms: Battery refuses to seat or releases mid-ride, BMS reports cell fault, no power after swap, or charger flags pack as incompatible.
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect and lubricate latch mechanism at swap, enforce BMS handshake validation, quarantine packs failing diagnostics, and replace worn latch springs.

failure_modes.name: Drum brake wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Longer stopping distance, grinding during braking, pedal/lever over-travel, or brake drag reducing range.
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled shoe inspection at service interval, replace worn shoes, recalibrate actuation, and capture braking telemetry to detect wear.

failure_modes.name: IoT dropout
failure_modes.symptoms: Unit disappears from fleet map, unlock fails, no heartbeat pings, or rides stuck 'in progress' after completion.
failure_modes.mitigation: Remote reboot, redundant carrier failover, antenna/SIM inspection, and module swap on persistent dropout.

failure_modes.name: Stem/folding mechanism failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Stem wobble or sudden collapse under rider weight, folding latch will not lock, creaking at hinge, or handlebars misaligned.
failure_modes.mitigation: Torque-check folding bolts at service, replace fatigued latch pins, mandatory lock-engagement verification before deployment, and retire cracked frames.

failure_modes.name: Tire wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Reduced tread depth, sidewall cracking, flat spots, or increased slip on wet surfaces.
failure_modes.mitigation: Tread-depth inspection at service, replace tires at limit, maintain correct pressure, and rotate to even wear.

failure_modes.name: Vandalism damage
failure_modes.symptoms: Cut cables, snapped stem, disabled lock, smashed display, or stripped ID tags found at recovery.
failure_modes.mitigation: Tamper-evident seals, geofenced idle alerts, rapid pickup of mis-parked units, and repair-or-retire triage.
